notes.title: Agatha Christie - The ABC Murder: Major update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we are publishing a major update for Agatha Christie – The ABC Murders.

With this update we reworked several aspects of the game:

·        A brand-new "Brain cells" interface reinforcing player’s immersion
·        A smoother gameplay to provide a better experience
·        Now 4K compatible
·        Framerate increased from locked 30FPS to 60FPS
·        Addition of multiple tutorials to guide players
·        New lighting effects
·        Reworked sound design
·        New anti-aliasing more on par with the artistic direction of the game

With those new additions, there is no better time to rediscover one of Hercule Poirot's most famous investigations!

notes.title: Update for Agatha Christie - The ABC Murders !
notes.content:
In order to provide you with a better gaming experience during your investigations, we’ve improved the game’s graphics, sound and gameplay!

Here’s a summary of the improvements we’ve made:
•	Polish added
•	Brazilian-Portuguese added
•	Various improvements.
•	Correction of minor bugs


GRAPHICS AND ANIMATIONS
	Corrected lip-synchronization
	Improvement of certain characters’ animations
	Improvement of looks exchanged by characters during certain dialogues
SOUNDS
	Added/corrected voices
	Some sounds have been improved and added (puddle, doors opening, suitcase, movements, etc.)
TEXT
	Corrected texts
	Size of emotion text improved
GAMEPLAY
	Improved camera and camera animations in certain scenes
	Certain collision zones in the puzzles have been reworked
	Some collision adjustments in the “little grey cells” menu
